verdict.rationale: First-party pricing docs say Vercel Sandbox runs in `iad1` (default), `sfo1`, `cle1` and `cdg1`, and that you can choose the region per sandbox or set a project default. That includes an EU option (`cdg1`), and a changelog entry says it is now available in all regions. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency guarantees for persisted state (snapshots, drives, auto-saved filesystems), clarity on the region list given the conflicting 'all regions' changelog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
